[[File:Natth_Cowling_render.png|thumb|250px|The Natth Cowling.]]

The dyeing process of these '''[[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]''' called for the use of water infused with [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] energy from [[Lake Natth]] on the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]]. Hence, the wearer of such robes experienced a slight increase to their strength.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only a dark-sided playable character can equip the robe.
